objects.name: Croc du Col
objects.lore: Hrold essuie toujours la lame avant de compter ceux qui ont franchi le col. Le givre bleu suit son tranchant ; les entailles de la garde, elles, ne disparaissent jamais.
objects.subject: The short straight sword held by Hrold in the reference: broad pointed double-edged pale steel blade, thin cyan frost luminous fuller, dark iron small swept crossguard like two angular wolf claws, black leather short grip and iron pommel. Entire sword, not a long sword. No shield, no character.
objects.scene: Sword resting diagonally on a battered stone parapet at a snowy mountain pass, a small fold of dark green cloak beneath the grip, distant gate simply painted. Cold dawn catching the edge, calm sparse background.
objects.ring: Worn gunmetal circular rim, small frost-blue inlaid groove, two subtle claw incisions and pale silver bevels.

objects.name: Hurlement Muet
objects.lore: Taevrik ne grave pas ses victoires sur la crosse. Il y marque les nuits où la patrouille est rentrée entière. Le canon reste froid longtemps après le dernier guetteur.
objects.flavour: On entend surtout ceux qui rentrent.
objects.subject: Taevrik's illustrated long straight dark iron sniper rifle with cylindrical telescope, narrow straight barrel, stock and receiver sculpted as an angular wolf head with silver fang ribs and controlled ice-blue crystal energy visible beneath. Full weapon in profile, not a modern plastic rifle, no extra barrel, no hands.
objects.scene: Rifle resting on folded dark green watch-cloak on a snowy stone lookout, empty path through pines in the far distance, restrained pale morning light. Weapon is the dominant readable subject.
objects.ring: Gunmetal circular scope mechanism with four short silver calibration notches and an icy blue inner light, worn iron wolf-fang engraving kept on the rim.

objects.name: Arc des Neiges Muettes
objects.lore: Nivra retend la corde avec les mêmes gestes que sa mère. Entre deux sapins, la flèche de givre indique un chemin que ses compagnons seuls savent lire.
objects.flavour: Une trace que le vent ne garde pas.
objects.subject: Nivra's slender symmetrical recurve bow from the reference: dark iron limbs with fine frost-blue channels, silver angular fittings, black leather central grip, one taut physically straight bowstring. One straight pale blue-tipped arrow placed beside it. Full bow, no drawn hands or character.
objects.scene: Bow and single arrow leaning against a weathered stone waymarker at the edge of a quiet snow-covered pine trail, fine frost on metal, no crowded props. Soft cold daylight.
objects.ring: Slim silver and dark iron circle with subtle curved bow-limb engravings confined to the band and tiny frost-blue accents.

objects.name: Brise-Rangs
objects.lore: Kaervan pose cette hache contre la porte avant d'appeler les absents. Sous le métal noir, trois crocs retiennent encore les fils rouges des manteaux qu'il a tirés hors de la neige.
objects.flavour: Ouvrir la ligne. Ramener les siens.
objects.subject: Kaervan's imposing battle axe exactly inspired by the reference: one enormous crescent steel cutting edge, black iron inner axe cheek with three curved fang-shaped cutouts, small red enamel inset and sculpted snarling wolf at socket, long perfectly straight leather-wrapped shaft, full haft and blade visible. Single axe, no human or extra weapon.
objects.scene: Heavy axe propped beside an iron fortress doorway with a strip of worn crimson cloth below it, snow drifting over dark stone, warm forge light through the doorway balancing cool snow. Sparse lived-in scene.
objects.ring: Heavy circular black iron rim, three inset silver fang wedges, restrained deep red enamel segments and scratched copper fastenings, a true circle not an axe-shaped frame.

objects.name: Crocs de Velours
objects.lore: Nyrska enveloppe ses deux dagues dans un ruban que sa sœur a recousu. Le velours a perdu sa couleur à force de voyages ; aucune des deux lames n'a perdu le chemin du retour.
objects.flavour: Deux crocs, un même chemin du retour.
objects.subject: Nyrska's matched pair of short combat daggers from the reference: narrow subtly swept silver blades with ice-blue edge glints, black metal angular claw guards, dark wrapped grips and restrained red ferrules. Two whole distinct short daggers, separate readable silhouettes, rigid unwarped blades, no long sword, no hands.
objects.scene: Twin daggers laid separately and diagonally on a folded worn crimson ribbon on a rough fortress bench beside a frosted window. Cold blue daylight and a modest warm interior reflection, quiet background.
objects.ring: Blackened silver circular rim with paired small fang motifs, muted crimson thread winding only around the outside band and a fine pale blue inner glint.

objects.name: Lame du Ralliement
objects.lore: Saevra n'élève pas la voix dans le blizzard. Elle lève sa lame, attend que chacun ait trouvé sa place, puis ouvre elle-même le premier pas dans la neige.
objects.flavour: Un éclat suffit pour se retrouver.
objects.subject: Saevra's long straight sword from the reference: slender double-edged polished steel blade with faint frost-blue line, compact black iron claw-shaped crossguard, dark leather grip and red accent at the pommel. Entire straight long blade, no bends, no character.
objects.scene: Sword leaning beside a stone map table in a winter command hall, one red banner far behind, folded unmarked letter by the grip, narrow daylight from a high window. Quiet and uncluttered, blade dominant.
objects.ring: Disciplined circular dark steel rim with narrow silver raised central band, four deep red enamel lozenges and a restrained ice-blue reflection.

objects.name: Tenue de la Garde Blanche
objects.lore: Sous les plaques rivetées, la laine verte porte le nom des cols traversés. La fourrure blanche n'est pas un grade : elle rappelle à chaque garde qu'il doit être visible pour ceux qui cherchent un refuge.
objects.flavour: Tenir le col, garder la chaleur.
objects.subject: Complete empty uniform inspired by Taevrik and Hrold: weathered dark forest-green layered long tunic and cloak, white fur-lined collar and trim, dark riveted steel shoulder plates with small silver star emblem, armored leather vest, belt, dark quilted trousers, gauntlets and boots arranged as a coherent single outfit. No mask, no rifle, no visible body, no floating body parts.
objects.scene: Uniform hanging on a simple wooden armor stand in a mountain guardroom, snowy stone doorway in the distance, gentle warm lamplight against cool window light. Full coat and armor visible; no wearer, no weapons.
objects.ring: Dark riveted iron circle with white fur texture restricted to the outside band, forest-green enamel accents and silver star rivets, clear hollow center.

objects.name: Tenue du Régiment Pourpre
objects.lore: La neige colle aux longs manteaux rouges bien avant de toucher l'acier. Chacun répare la doublure du suivant : au matin, personne ne demande à qui appartenaient les coutures.
objects.flavour: Le froid n'emportera pas le dernier.
objects.subject: Empty Froz regiment uniform from the reference: sumptuous but weathered long deep crimson shaggy fur military coat over buckled black armored leather vest, black angular steel pauldrons, dark quilted armored trousers and plated boots, red beret with small iron star resting alongside collar. No wearer, no axe, no crystal bandolier because it is a separate relic.
objects.scene: Red fur uniform on a simple iron armor stand beside a frost-covered fortress window, cold stone, folded red cloth and a subtle warm lantern reflection, uncluttered background. Coat dominant, no human.
objects.ring: Black iron circular armor rim with restrained crimson fur on the outer band and small riveted steel plates, silver bevel, no bright magical glow.

objects.name: Muselière du Souffle Calme
objects.lore: Le masque conduit le givre loin de la gorge et rend chaque souffle régulier. Quand les voix de la patrouille se font moins nombreuses, ce rythme discret rappelle au porteur qu'il peut encore tenir.
objects.flavour: Un souffle calme au milieu du manque.
objects.condition: Après avoir survécu à une attaque en infériorité numérique : +40 DEF pour le prochain duel à défense chiffrée. Une fois par partie.
objects.subject: The exact Grivka protective muzzle-mask seen on Taevrik: rigid fitted angular black gunmetal muzzle cup for an elongated wolf muzzle, overlapping armored bridge plates, open narrow vertical breathing slots below, small cyan luminous vents on either cheek, dark leather straps with buckles. Show as standalone relic in three-quarter view with hollow interior, no face or head, not a skull or gas mask.
objects.scene: Muzzle-mask placed carefully on a folded dark green scarf on a stone windowsill, a fine pale condensation curl at one blue vent, snowy pass beyond. Intimate restrained still life, mask large and readable.
objects.ring: Circular dark overlapping armor slats like the muzzle vents, pale cyan inset channels at four intervals, cold silver bevel and tiny breath-like light confined to outer band.

objects.name: Bandoulière du Givre Captif
objects.lore: Les deux veines bleues de la bandoulière ramènent la morsure de la magie vers son cristal. Les soldats de Froz disent qu'il garde un peu de chaque tempête pour les aider à traverser la suivante.
objects.flavour: Garder la tempête pour le bon instant.
objects.condition: Après avoir survécu à une attaque magique : +40 ATK à la prochaine attaque magique chiffrée conservée. Une fois par partie.
objects.subject: Froz's distinctive crystal shoulder bandolier from Kaervan reference: long dark leather diagonal cross-body strap with two parallel thin ice-blue luminous channels, one large brilliant faceted pale cyan diamond crystal at shoulder set in an angular silver-black spiked star metal mount, sturdy lower buckle. Entire strap laid in a relaxed loop, no torso or coat, no ammunition or weapon.
objects.scene: Crystal bandolier laid diagonally across worn crimson cloak on a dark stone supply table near a frosted fortress window. The crystal lights only nearby leather; background simple and quiet, object dominant.
objects.ring: Black leather and riveted iron circular band with two fine parallel ice-blue luminous inlays, small angular pale cyan crystal sockets spaced around the perimeter, restrained silver trim.
